records.title: Ripple expands collaboration with BNY across custody and tokenized trade finance
records.summary: BNY states it now supports XRP and RLUSD on its Digital Asset Custody platform; BNY is primary RLUSD reserve custodian and has a custody relationship with Ripple Prime. Mint/redeem RLUSD through BNY and tokenized trade-finance initiatives are future plans subject to final approvals and client requirements.
records.limitations: Joint BNY/Ripple announcement; no client-level XRP assets-under-custody, inflow or utilization amounts disclosed; future plans are conditional.

records.title: C2FO and Ripple partner to modernize trade finance using the XRP Ledger
records.summary: C2FO Instant Pay is described as using RLUSD on XRPL for supplier settlement, funded by participating capital providers; the announcement describes a limited rollout/waitlist and more than $520B historical C2FO Early Pay activity.
records.limitations: No deployed Instant Pay volume, named capital-provider commitments or XRP purchases disclosed; historical Early Pay volume is not XRPL capital.

records.title: Instant Pay
records.summary: C2FO describes early payment against approved invoices with participating capital providers and a limited rollout/waitlist.
records.limitations: Product availability and actual settlement volumes are not publicly quantified.

records.title: Clearinghouse accepted collateral schedule
records.summary: Published collateral table lists XRP with a 40% haircut and a $15M notional limit; Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC appears among clearing members.
records.limitations: Eligibility and limits do not disclose actual XRP collateral posted, utilization, customer identities or current balances; schedule is venue-specific.

records.title: Ripple Prime institutional prime brokerage
records.summary: Ripple Prime says clients can post RLUSD, XRP, tokenized RWAs or traditional collateral and cross-margin exposures across supported asset classes.
records.limitations: Product-page statement; supported jurisdictions, haircuts, limits and actual XRP collateral utilization are not disclosed on the page.

records.title: Ripple closes Hidden Road acquisition
records.summary: Ripple says the acquisition is complete and Hidden Road is now Ripple Prime; certain derivatives customers had opted to hold balances in RLUSD and RLUSD was being used as collateral in prime-brokerage products.
records.limitations: Company statement; does not quantify XRP collateral utilization or prove every Hidden Road legal entity has identical operational scope.

records.title: Standard Chartered launches RLUSD custody and joins planned collateral integration with Ripple and LMAX Group
records.summary: Standard Chartered's DIFC branch offers RLUSD custody on XRPL; collateral mirroring with LMAX is planned and subject to documentation, testing and regulatory approvals.
records.limitations: Live custody does not establish live LMAX collateral use; no XRP custody or XRP collateral support is asserted.

records.title: Ripple launches support for institutions to access real-world-asset perpetual swaps
records.summary: Ripple Prime says institutional clients including Virtu are trading RWA swaps across 100+ reference markets; RLUSD can be used as collateral for these swaps.
records.limitations: Company statement; RLUSD collateral is specified for this product, not XRP; volumes and collateral balances are undisclosed.

records.title: Ripple and Coinbase partner to expand access to RLUSD
records.summary: RLUSD became available on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and retail products, with XRPL, Base and Ethereum deposits/withdrawals; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral functionality was described as future availability.
records.limitations: Listing/distribution is live; Global Exchange collateral use is not yet established as live; no XRP purchase or collateral volume disclosed.

records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings
records.summary: Coinbase reports 10.7% global crypto trading-volume share, $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products, prediction markets above $200M annualized revenue and subscription/services representing about 49% of net revenue.
records.limitations: Company-reported measures; USDC balances are customer-held, not Coinbase-owned XRP capital; revenue mix does not establish XRP flows.

records.title: USDC transparency and circulation
records.summary: As-of-October-26 snapshot reports approximately $71.0B USDC circulation and $71.2B reserves, with recent 7-day and 30-day circulation contraction.
records.limitations: Global USDC figures are not XRPL-specific; not all reserve assets are held at BNY; figures are a dated snapshot.

records.title: XRPL stablecoin market capitalization
records.summary: XRPL stablecoin capitalization about $1.083B; RLUSD about $991.98M or 91.59%; 7-day total +4.96% and 30-day total -11%; USDC about $4.47M.
records.limitations: Aggregator coverage and timestamp are not equivalent to issuer attestations; market capitalization is not transaction volume or new capital.

records.title: XRPL chain activity and DeFi dashboard
records.summary: Dashboard reports TVL about $321.09M, DEX volume about $4.2M for the displayed day, seven-day DEX volume down about 24.86%, roughly 48,537 active addresses and 4.41M transactions.
records.limitations: Transaction and active-address counts can include automated/non-economic activity; aggregator definitions and cutoffs must be retained.

records.title: Spot XRP ETF holdings and flow reconstruction
records.summary: Reports about +3.44M XRP net holdings change over four settled trading days, total holdings about 1.19665B XRP and estimated average cost basis around $1.71 versus a contemporaneous price near $1.25.
records.limitations: Holdings-delta reconstruction; GXRP excluded from flow calculation due capture gap; BITW index rebalancing and fee accruals can affect deltas; estimated cost basis is not investor-level realized P&L.

records.title: XRP market snapshot
records.summary: 15:38 UTC snapshot reports XRP near $1.2477, 24-hour change about -3.92%, 7-day -5%, 30-day -16.2% and YTD -31.6%; relative XRP/BTC change was positive in that provider snapshot.
records.limitations: Snapshot is roughly five hours old at the current cutoff; provider price and 24-hour windows are not synchronized with other venues.

records.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
records.title: Ripple National Trust Bank corporate application status
records.summary: OCC Corporate Applications Search shows Ripple National Trust Bank as consummated/effective on October 26, 2026.
records.limitations: Legal status does not establish that all planned products, reserve management or client services are already operational.

records.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
records.title: First National Digital Currency Bank corporate application status
records.summary: OCC Corporate Applications Search shows First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. as consummated/effective on July 24, 2026; Circle identifies the entity as its national trust bank.
records.limitations: Charter status does not prove that reserve-management or all public-facing services have commenced.

records.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
records.title: Corporate Applications Search
records.summary: OCC list records an approved application for Coinbase National Trust Company dated April 2, 2026; no consummated/effective entry was found in the reviewed record by the October 30 cutoff.
records.limitations: Absence of an effective entry in the reviewed record is not proof that no later filing exists; Coinbase itself described the action as conditional approval.

records.title: Coinbase receives conditional OCC approval
records.summary: Coinbase describes conditional OCC approval for Coinbase National Trust Company.
records.limitations: Conditional approval is not the same as consummated/effective status or commencement of trust operations.

records.title: Circle receives final OCC approval to establish national trust bank
records.summary: Circle announced final OCC approval for First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.; the OCC CAS later records consummated/effective status on July 24.
records.limitations: Circle's announcement described future operating phases; actual commencement of all planned services is not verified.

records.title: Ripple receives final OCC approval to establish national trust bank
records.summary: Ripple announced final OCC approval to establish Ripple National Trust Bank; OCC CAS records consummated/effective status the same date.
records.limitations: Operational launch and actual migration of RLUSD reserve custody are not verified.

records.title: BlackRock Funds Circle Reserve Fund prospectus and statement of additional information
records.summary: SEC-filed Circle Reserve Fund documents identify The Bank of New York Mellon as custodian and BNY Mellon Investment Servicing as transfer agent; Circle entities hold the fund shares as part of stablecoin reserves.
records.limitations: This is one reserve fund component, not proof that all USDC reserves are held at BNY; fund is a BlackRock-managed government money-market fund.

records.title: Ripple reports banner year, approaching $900M product revenue run rate
records.summary: Ripple reports an approximately $900M annualized product revenue run rate, 1,700+ institutional customers, 60+ payout markets and large cross-product transaction volumes.
records.limitations: Company-reported annualized run rate and activity metrics are not audited XRP demand, spot purchases or collateral balances.

records.title: Always-on corporate treasury platform and 24/7 Returns
records.summary: Ripple Treasury describes always-on treasury operations and 24/7 Returns for eligible digital assets, including RLUSD.
records.limitations: Yield source, assets under program, customer balances and actual returns are not disclosed in the reviewed release; do not assume XRP is yield-bearing under this product.

records.title: FOMC statement October 28, 2026
records.summary: FOMC held the federal funds target range at 3.75%-4.00% by a 10-2 vote; two voters preferred a 25bp increase; statement cites elevated inflation and geopolitical uncertainty.
records.limitations: Macro context is not an XRP-specific causal explanation; policy effects require synchronized cross-asset controls.

records.title: GDP advance estimate, third quarter 2026
records.summary: Real GDP rose at a 3.4% annualized rate in Q3 2026; PCE price index rose 2.1% annualized and core PCE 2.5% annualized in the quarter.
records.limitations: Advance estimate is subject to revision; quarterly annualized rates must not be confused with year-over-year inflation.

records.title: Personal income and outlays, September 2026
records.summary: September PCE price index rose 0.5% month over month and 3.6% year over year; core PCE rose 0.3% month over month and 3.1% year over year.
records.limitations: One month of inflation data; not a standalone predictor of crypto prices.

records.title: Crypto prices fall after Binance security incident and broader market risk-off
records.summary: Reuters reports broad crypto weakness alongside the Binance security incident and a wider technology/equity selloff.
records.limitations: Multiple concurrent shocks confound causal attribution to the Binance incident alone.

records.title: BNY expands relationship with Circle and adds stablecoin enablement services
records.summary: BNY says USDC was the first stablecoin on its Digital Asset Custody platform, enabling institutional clients to store, transfer, mint and burn USDC through BNY/Circle workflows.
records.limitations: Does not mean all USDC reserves are at BNY or that USDC is natively issued on XRPL through BNY.

records.title: Binance reserves $6.34B for security incident; $5B already held in affected tokens
records.summary: Binance says it reserved more than $6.34B, already holds about $5B in affected tokens and expects to acquire roughly $1.34B through market and OTC channels; about $3B is separately frozen.
records.limitations: No XRP-specific acquisition amount, transaction hash or reconciliation to the observed XRP wallet route disclosed.

records.title: Ripple-attributed XRPL account rJqi
records.summary: Bithomp labels the account as Xaman Account: Ripple and records activation by a Ripple-labelled account; balance snapshot about 30.5M XRP.
records.limitations: Provider attribution is not a signed statement of beneficial ownership; account label must remain qualified.

records.title: XRPL account raRVLN
records.summary: Account page reports no username and a balance around 19.6M XRP.
records.limitations: No account owner or beneficial controller identified; balance is point-in-time and explorer-indexed.

records.title: XRPL account raRVLN account-object classification
records.summary: Explorer identifies raRVLN as an AMM pool and says it belongs to a vault and a loan broker.
records.limitations: Underlying AMM pair, vault identity, loan-broker identity and asset composition were not loaded because the explorer reported rate limits; classification is not proof that a particular transfer was collateral.

records.title: raRVLN XRPL transaction history
records.summary: Visible records include 120M XRP from Ripple-labelled rJqi at 08:30, 35M XRP from the same account at 20:07, 19.5M XRP from r3mSX at 06:47, six XRP payments totaling 186M to r39TA from 13:44-14:09, and a further 20M XRP to r39TA at 20:16.
records.limitations: Only the latest 10 transactions were visible; other inflows/outflows exist or may exist. Do not attribute all outflows to Ripple or infer a sale/collateral purpose.

records.title: XRPL account r39TA
records.summary: Account has no username, was activated by an unlabelled account and displayed a balance around 25.9M XRP.
records.limitations: No beneficial owner or service label identified.

records.title: r39TA XRPL transaction history
records.summary: Visible entries show 68,924,571.602513 XRP sent in four 15,929,908.403027 XRP payments, one 5,204,135.1 XRP payment and one 802.890405 XRP payment to Binance-labelled rNxp4h with destination tag 499932645. The same visible window includes 60M gross RLUSD inbound from Ripple-labelled issuers and 30M gross RLUSD outbound to a Ripple-labelled issuer.
records.limitations: Visible window is only 13 of many transactions; no complete account ledger, net RLUSD balance, swap execution or source-unit provenance established.

records.title: Binance XRPL account rNxp4h
records.summary: Bithomp labels rNxp4h as Binance, reports about 184.2M XRP, says it was activated by Binance-labelled rDAE53 and is signer for five addresses.
records.limitations: Binance label and activation graph do not establish whether this is a hot, cold, deposit or reserve wallet; not itself identified as one of the five compromised sources.

records.title: Binance XRPL account rDAE53
records.summary: Bithomp identifies rDAE53 as Binance; this is one of the five Binance-attributed accounts involved in the 233.46M XRP incident and the activating account for rNxp4h.
records.limitations: Provider wallet labels are attribution evidence, not legal ownership records; exact PoR inclusion remains unknown.

records.title: Binance hack XRP destination status update
records.summary: Reports the attacker receiver still held approximately 233.46M XRP with no outgoing transfers through a 14:40 UTC observation.
records.limitations: Secondary report and stale relative to the 20:40 UTC cutoff; direct explorer refresh of receiver was unavailable in this run.
